security_voluntary_transfer_004.answer: A voluntary transfer is a teacher request for a change in teaching position. Procedures involve collaboratively negotiated guidelines, application via form/timeline, and seniority playing a key role (at least 50% of interviewees must be the most senior). Temporary/remainder contract positions are vacated for this process. Eligibility requires being recommended for reappointment, in-field, Highly Qualified, not on DROP/temporary contract, and meeting annual requirements.

The voluntary transfer process shall be consistent with the intent to Transfer application form and the corresponding timeline. ... A minimum of 50% of the applicants chosen for interview must be the most senior applicants. ... Positions which are filled at the conclusion of the school year by long-term substitutes, temporary or remainder of year probationary contracts in non-protected assignments shall be vacated for use in the voluntary and involuntary transfer process. ... security_rif_006.answer: If economic circumstances dictate a reduction, the Board must assign personnel to appropriate qualified positions. If unable to maintain all employees, the Board must immediately meet with the Union Association to establish an orderly method of reducing, retraining, and recalling affected employees.
security_rif_006.evidence: Should economic circumstances dictate a reduction in personnel, the Board shall take whatever steps are necessary to assign personnel to appropriate positions within the district for which they are qualified, consistent with this Agreement and law. Should the Board be unable to maintain all employees, it shall immediately meet with the Union Association to provide for an orderly method of reducing, retraining, and recalling affected employees.
